speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wise Man. The Lord Admiral his servants. I have read it. That is the whole of the errand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not crossing the river for another company's afternoon. The house is dark until the new year, and that is the house I belong to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The close, and the stair, and the leaf. The post can keep its nail.
